name: prelaunch-accounting
goal: Never report a model execution that did not start

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A context or CLI resource/spawn failure before provider execution must not be counted as a model execution or assigned token usage.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing accounting test assumed a real context would start in the fixture and did not assert zero provider calls for context or prelaunch failures; cover both with isolated synthetic contexts.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Separated prelaunch and ambiguous historical outcomes in 134d237580, preserving event identities.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Recorded passing regression b485876f at 134d237580; checked SQLite event replacement without a provider call.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
